name: Kaidou Eiji
source:
A warrior class which physical and fire melee attacks.

Eiji is known as Kaitos Erzey (カイトス・エルゼイ). Due to the curse of Binds, he returned into his younger body. And thus, joining Agaresta Academy as a transfer student, in class 2-A.

Later he will help Liliam to catch all of the escaped Binds, together.
